# Improvestu

> Improvestu is the Shot Call'a Games, LLC initiative behind FARU (campus carpool) and FASU (study buddy) for verified college students.

## Company
- URL: https://www.improvestu.com/
- Contact: improvestu@gmail.com

## FARU — Find A Ride University
- URL: https://www.improvestu.com/faru/
- Campus carpool message board: chat first, meet on campus, ride with classmates. Not a taxi or rideshare dispatch service.
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.faru.faru
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/faru-find-a-ride-university/id6801682857
- Privacy: https://www.improvestu.com/faru/privacy/
- Terms: https://www.improvestu.com/faru/terms/

## FASU — Find A Study-Buddy University
- URL: https://www.improvestu.com/fasu/
- Campus study matching: find classmates by course, schedule, and study style. Study Now, flashcards, tutoring discovery, accountability. No AI tutors.
- Free core for verified students; FASU+ $4.99/mo or $49.99/yr
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fasu.fasu
- Privacy: https://www.improvestu.com/fasu/privacy/
- Terms: https://www.improvestu.com/fasu/terms/
